page_title: WOL 1-2 NEW | Wolves v Newcastle 15/09/2024, Stats - Flashscore.com | Match

commentary.text: 90+9' The referee blows his whistle for the final time to end this match.
90+8' Harvey Barnes (Newcastle Utd) is first to react to a loose pass inside the box, but slices his shot just wide of the right post.
90+8' Joao Gomes (Wolves) attempts to find one of his teammates, but puts far too much on the pass and the chance is gone.
90+6' The expression of the referee Chris Kavanagh is crystal clear. This behaviour won't be tolerated. Jacob Murphy (Newcastle Utd) is shown a yellow card.

90+3' Matheus Cunha (Wolves) releases a powerful first-time effort from the edge of the box which goes in the direction of the crossbar, but the keeper leaps like a salmon to deny him. Excellent goalkeeping!
90+2' Craig Dawson (Wolves) sends a promising through ball, but the defence is alert and cuts out the pass.
90' 8 min. of stoppage-time to be played.
89' What a sweet touch by Sandro Tonali (Newcastle Utd) as he collects a pass deep inside the box and decides to go for goal. It's on target but easy for Sam Johnstone to hold.
87' Gary O'Neil has decided to substitute Jorgen Strand Larsen and he is replaced by Goncalo Guedes (Wolves).
86' The game has come to an end for Bruno Guimaraes. He has contributed as much as he could today. He will be replaced by the fresh legs of Lloyd Kelly (Newcastle Utd).
86' The referee stops play so that a substitution can be made and Rayan Ait-Nouri trots off the pitch and is replaced by Carlos Forbs (Wolves).
84' Rayan Ait-Nouri (Wolves) is down injured and the referee stops play so that he can receive medical treatment.
84' Mario Lemina (Wolves) deprives his opponent of the ball, but the referee blows his whistle for a foul. He's not happy with the decision!
84' The actual number of corner kicks in this match – 4:7.
83' Wolves are happy showing off their ball keeping skills and that is only interrupted when the defender steps in.

80' 1 - 2 What a spectacular moment! Harvey Barnes (Newcastle Utd) skips past defenders and finds some space before blasting a long-range strike at goal. The fans are amazed when they see the ball go into the top right corner. The scoreline is 1:2.
79' The referee points to the corner flag. It's a corner to Newcastle.
79' Newcastle keep possession of the ball by producing one-two passes, but an opponent steps in and wins the ball.
79' Thomas Doyle (Wolves) launches a cross from the corner, but Nick Pope is alert to thwart the effort.
78' Matheus Cunha (Wolves) receives a sweet pass inside the box, but his effort on goal is blocked by the defender. The referee signals a corner kick to Wolves.
77' The referee stops play so that a substitution can be made and Thomas Doyle is coming onto the pitch as Andre (Wolves) cannot continue after picking up an injury.
77' Here's the change. Nelson Semedo leaves the pitch and Matt Doherty (Wolves) comes on as a substitute.

75' 1 - 1 Nice piece of skill by Fabian Schar (Newcastle Utd). He perfectly collected a pass from Bruno Guimaraes, then unleashed a fantastic long-range strike which went into the top left corner. The score is 1:1.
73' The foul by Andre (Wolves) is worthy of a card and a yellow is duly shown by Chris Kavanagh.
72' Kieran Trippier (Newcastle Utd) takes the corner, but it's intercepted by the defender.
72' Bruno Guimaraes (Newcastle Utd) sends a pass into the box, but his attempt is thwarted and cleared. Newcastle earn a corner.
71' The referee signals that it is time for a substitution and Hee-Chan Hwang (Wolves) comes onto the pitch so that Jean-Ricner Bellegarde can be given a rest.
70' Nelson Semedo (Wolves) is awarded a yellow card for his tackle. He doesn't seem to agree with the decision, but Chris Kavanagh ignores the protests.
68' Matheus Cunha (Wolves) runs onto a loose pass inside the box and releases a tremendous shot towards the right side of the goal. However, Nick Pope anticipates the shot and makes a brilliant save.
67' Sam Johnstone leaps to collect the ball from the corner which was sent over by Kieran Trippier (Newcastle Utd).
67' Harvey Barnes (Newcastle Utd) makes space for himself in the box after some nice work, but his shot is immediately charged down by a defender. Newcastle have been awarded a corner kick.
67' Newcastle are showing great team chemistry. They are passing it around beautifully. Excellent team work.
64' Kieran Trippier (Newcastle Utd) floats the free kick into the box, but it's easily cleared by the first man.
64' The referee stops play so that a substitution can be made and Valentino Livramento leaves the pitch and Kieran Trippier (Newcastle Utd) comes on.
63' Rayan Ait-Nouri (Wolves) can't expect anything else than a yellow card for his hard tackle. And a yellow it is. Chris Kavanagh didn't think twice about pulling it out of his pocket.
62' A wild effort from Matheus Cunha (Wolves) on the edge of the box flies well wide of the right post. The ball is off of the pitch and it's a goal kick for Newcastle.
62' Jorgen Strand Larsen (Wolves) rises above the defenders and places a towering header low towards the middle of the goal, but Nick Pope is prepared and thwarts him.
61' Wolves are showing great team chemistry. They are passing it around beautifully. Excellent team work.
59' Lewis Hall (Newcastle Utd) takes the corner which is cleared by the opposition's defence.

59' Joe Willock (Newcastle Utd) sends a beautiful cross into the penalty area, but the opposition's defence manages to clear the ball to safety. The ball goes out of play. Newcastle are awarded a corner kick.
58' Wolves have a chance to score from a corner kick, but the ball is cleared by a defender.
58' Nelson Semedo (Wolves) whips the ball into the penalty area, but one of the defenders is alert and spanks it away. The ball goes out for a corner. Wolves can continue in their attacking effort.
56' An attempted cross from Harvey Barnes (Newcastle Utd) is cleared.
56' Shots on target – 2:2.
53' Jorgen Strand Larsen (Wolves) storms into the box to get on the end of a pass, but smashes his shot straight onto the right post. Unlucky!
52' The main referee, Chris Kavanagh, is apparently not going to tolerate any discussions. Dan Burn (Newcastle Utd) is given a yellow card for dissent.
51' Wonderful movement by Wolves. The players are holding possession, mostly exchanging one-touch passes. They control the pace of the game now.
49' Anthony Gordon (Newcastle Utd) gets on the end of a good pass and from mid-range he unleashes a decent strike, but the shot is blocked by the defender.
48' Now Newcastle have a corner.

47' An unsuccessful long-range effort by Bruno Guimaraes (Newcastle Utd) after he collected a pass and unleashed a shot. The ball was directed towards the right post, but it was an easy job for the goalkeeper to make a save.
46' Half-time substitution. Eddie Howe decided to make a change. Joelinton (Newcastle Utd) is replaced by Joe Willock.
46' The need to improve in the second half has brought about a change. Alexander Isak (Newcastle Utd) comes off for Harvey Barnes.
46' Eddie Howe has decided to make a substitution during the half-time break. Sandro Tonali comes on the pitch for Sean Longstaff (Newcastle Utd).
46' The referee blows his whistle to signal the start of the second half.
45+3' The referee blows his whistle to end the first half and the players are now heading to their respective dressing rooms.
45+1' Alexander Isak (Newcastle Utd) requires medical treatment, so the referee stops play and signals for the physio to come onto the pitch.
45' We will have 1 min. of added time.
45' Anthony Gordon (Newcastle Utd) serves up a nice cross, but the defence clears the danger.

43' Mario Lemina (Wolves) finds himself in space on the edge of the box and tries to catch the keeper out, but the shot lacks accuracy and curls well wide of the right post. The ball is off of the pitch and it's a goal kick for Newcastle.

43' Wolves slow the tempo of the game down by exchanging a combination of one or two touch passes. The opposition's players are finding it very difficult at the moment, very physically demanding to run without the ball.
40' Rayan Ait-Nouri (Wolves) sends a chip pass into the box, but Nick Pope is quickest to intercept the ball.
40' Foul! Sean Longstaff (Newcastle Utd) is penalised for pulling back his opponent.
38' Chris Kavanagh shows a yellow card to Joelinton (Newcastle Utd) for a tough tackle.

36' 1 - 0 It's a goal! Jorgen Strand Larsen plays a lovely pass into the box and finds Mario Lemina (Wolves). He tries his luck from close range and coolly strikes the ball into the back of the net. 1:0.
34' Newcastle failed to take advantage of the corner as the opposition's defence was alert and averted the threat.
34' Newcastle are happy showing off their ball keeping skills and that is only interrupted when the defender steps in. The ball is out of play. Newcastle win a corner kick.
32' Rayan Ait-Nouri (Wolves) works the corner short.
32' The resulting corner from Matheus Cunha (Wolves) is cleared by the opposition's defence. The linesman makes the right call and Wolves will have a corner.
28' Jean-Ricner Bellegarde (Wolves) makes a good run with the ball into the box, but mishits his shot as it goes high over the bar. The ball goes out of play and Newcastle will have a goal kick.
26' Alexander Isak (Newcastle Utd) commits a foul and Chris Kavanagh immediately signals a free kick.
25' A pass lands at the feet of Matheus Cunha (Wolves) in the middle of the box, he looks up and shoots but the effort is superbly blocked by a defender.
24' Jean-Ricner Bellegarde (Wolves) crosses into the box from near the side line, but he doesn't connect as he wanted and it's cleared by the well-organized defence.
23' Off the post! Anthony Gordon (Newcastle Utd) amazingly found his way through the defence, but lacked a precise finish as his effort from close range bounced off the right post.
20' Jacob Murphy (Newcastle Utd) is adjudged offside.
19' Newcastle seem to be finding their feet as they enjoy some possession. Great movement by the offensive players allows the defenders to set up the attack.

17' Matheus Cunha (Wolves) sends a lofted cross into the penalty area. Unfortunately for him, the opponent's defence deals with his cross comfortably and intercepts it. The ball has crossed the sideline. Wolves are taking a throw-in.
14' Anthony Gordon (Newcastle Utd) looks to break free, but an opposing player clears the ball away. The referee and the linesman both signal a throw-in for Newcastle.
13' Valentino Livramento (Newcastle Utd) was trying to get to the ball but clattered into the legs of the opponent as well. Chris Kavanagh blows his whistle for an infringement.

12' Nelson Semedo (Wolves) controls a neat pass and has options, but decides to shoot from distance. The ball flies low towards the middle of the net, but Nick Pope is well positioned to make a comfortable save.

10' Long passes, short passes and one-two passes. Newcastle are showcasing great team work by keeping possession and producing pin-point passes from player to player. The opposition's players are finding it very difficult to intercept at the moment.
8' Newcastle quickly take a corner kick with a short pass.

8' Jacob Murphy (Newcastle Utd) receives a precise low pass inside the box, controls the ball and releases it under the roof. Unfortunately for him, Sam Johnstone makes a great save to stop his effort. Newcastle have been awarded a corner kick.
5' Alexander Isak (Newcastle Utd) makes a run into the box and gets on the end of a cross, but his well-taken shot crashes into a defender and is cleared away.
4' A cross into the box from Jacob Murphy (Newcastle Utd) is cleared. The ball is out of play. Newcastle will have a throw-in.
3' Bruno Guimaraes (Newcastle Utd) dinks a cross into the box in an attempt to find one of his teammates, but the defence manages to clear.
2' Chris Kavanagh blows his whistle and it's Matheus Cunha (Wolves) who is penalised for an offensive foul. Good decision by the referee.
1' The match has just started.
Newcastle will kick the game off.
Chris Kavanagh was nominated as the referee for this game.
